rationale: Identity was verified correctly using full name and ZIP, and the agent acted only on the authenticated user’s orders. However, the agent changed the delivery address on pending order #W6750959 immediately after stating the address from the other order, without first obtaining explicit user confirmation to proceed. Policy requires stating the exact change and obtaining explicit confirmation before any order-changing write. For the Bluetooth speaker change, the agent did follow policy by confirming before modifying the item and used the stored payment method for the price difference. One minor concern: the agent asserted that the refund had been issued without explicit tool confirmation. The primary failure is the unconfirmed address modification, so the conversation does not meet the pass bar.
